description: Testbenches shipped: the bit-exact, golden-model and bank-alias benches, the mutation check, the runner and the verification workflow, with the cold-start run from verification/README.md in a fresh venv.

argv: set -e; T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT; python3 -m venv "$T/venv"; "$T/venv/bin/pip" install -q -r verification/requirements.txt; EXPECT_ICARUS=13.0 "$T/venv/bin/python" verification/runner.py --records-dir "$T/records" --build-dir "$T/build"; PYTHON="$T/venv/bin/python" ./verification/check_mutation.sh
